==Description==
The '''Crying Angel''' was an enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. For its debut, it had a medium amount of health and a below average speed. It was also a [[Flying]] enemy, meaning that you needed to use towers with flying detection to kill it. It was immune to being frozen and slowed down by freezing towers.

It could be spawned by the [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from its ''Secret Santa'' ability.

==Appearance==
The '''Crying Angel''' was entirely made out of translucent blue ice. Its torso and legs were darker than its head and arms. It had two light blue wings connected to its torso with blue chains, which were wrapped around its torso. It also had a light blue spiked halo floating above its head.

==Strategy==
*The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]] can deal great amounts of damage to this enemy.
**Keep in mind that due to the speed of '''Crying Angels''', they can escape the range of these two towers.
*The [[Mortar]] can clear out hordes of '''Crying Angels''' quickly, while also dealing a lot of damage to other enemies that appear.
*Multiple [[Golden Soldier]]s can be very effective against this.
*A couple Level 0 [[Ranger]]s can kill the '''Crying Angel''' pretty easily, due to their high range and damage.
*A couple of [[Electroshocker]]s can clear out hordes of '''Crying Angels''' due to their chaining, although keep in mind their low firerate, low range and the speed of the '''Crying Angels'''.  
*While towers with flying detection are the only consistent way to kill '''Crying Angels''', other towers can damage them indirectly.
**With the exception of the [[Mortar]], [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], explosive towers cannot detect the '''Crying Angel'''. If another enemy that can be detected by such a tower is present, then the '''Crying Angel''' can be damaged, so long it is within the explosion radius.
**The '''Crying Angel''' can get hit if it is in chain reaction with the [[Electroshocker]] even before it is at Level 2.
**The [[Sledger]] and [[Gladiator]] will be able to hit the '''Crying Angel''' if another detectable enemy is nearby as their hitboxes can hit the '''Crying Angel'''.

==Trivia==
*The '''Crying Angel's''' name may be based on the [[w:c:tardis:Weeping Angel|Weeping Angel]] from ''Doctor Who''.
*On the 24th of December 2023, it was stated officially that the '''Crying Angel's''' health was lowered, despite no actual change occurring.
*The '''Crying Angel's''' wings were uploaded to the Roblox catalog as the {{RLinkC|15696220879|Crying Angel Wings}} UGC accessory.
